```{r seurat_standard}

library(Seurat)
library(Azimuth)
library(celldex)
library(glmGamPoi)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(future)
library(DoubletFinder)  
library(dplyr)          


# Set working directory 

work_dir <- "~/SynologyDrive/NeuroD_2024/"
setwd(work_dir)

plotdir <- file.path(work_dir, "plots/revision")
dir.create(plotdir, showWarnings = FALSE)
cellranger_dir <- "/Volumes/centren/AG/AG-Newman/Newman/NeuroD scRNAseq/2024/A4794/"



# Load data
# Adjust each path to point to the folder containing "raw_feature_bc_matrix"
# This Data is from E15 cortex


NeuroD2_D6DKO <- Read10X(data.dir = file.path(cellranger_dir,
                                              "A4794_SP278_NeuroD2_D6DKO/outs",
                                              "filtered_feature_bc_matrix"))

WT <- Read10X(data.dir = file.path(cellranger_dir,
                                   "A4794_SP278_wt/outs",
                                   "filtered_feature_bc_matrix"))


# Prefix cell barcodes to make them unique
colnames(NeuroD2_D6DKO) <- paste0("NeuroD2_D6DKO_", colnames(NeuroD2_D6DKO))
colnames(WT) <- paste0("WT_", colnames(WT))

# Combine matrices (rows are genes, columns are cells)

#combined_counts <- cbind(NeuroD1KO, NeuroD2_D6DKO, NeuroDTKO, WT)
combined_counts <- cbind(NeuroD2_D6DKO, WT)

# Add metadata
meta_data <- data.frame(
  Genotype = factor(
    c(rep("NeuroD2_D6DKO", ncol(NeuroD2_D6DKO)),
      rep("WT", ncol(WT))),
    levels = c("WT", "NeuroD2_D6DKO")
  ),
  row.names = colnames(combined_counts)
)

# Create a Seurat object

options(Seurat.object.assay.calcn = TRUE)
sc_seurat <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts = combined_counts,
  min.cells = 3,
  min.features = 200,
  meta.data = meta_data
)

#Remove sparse matrices to save RAM
rm(NeuroD2_D6DKO,  WT)

saveRDS(sc_seurat, file = file.path(work_dir, "seurat_pre_filter.rds"))
# Calculate QC metrics: percent of mitochondrial and ribosomal genes

sc_seurat[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(sc_seurat, pattern = "^mt-")
sc_seurat[["percent.rbp"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(sc_seurat, pattern = "^Rp[sl]")

# Pre-filter QC plots

VlnPlot(sc_seurat, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt", "percent.rbp"), ncol = 4)
ggsave(filename = file.path(plotdir, "QC_combined_pre-filter.pdf"), width = 20, height = 18, units = "cm")

# Filter cells
# Adjust thresholds as appropriate 
sc_seurat <- subset(sc_seurat, subset = nFeature_RNA > 400 & percent.mt < 5)

# Post-filter QC plots
VlnPlot(sc_seurat, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt", "percent.rbp"), ncol = 4)
ggsave(filename = file.path(plotdir, "QC_combined_post-filter.pdf"), width = 20, height = 18, units = "cm")

# allow up to 40 GB
options(future.globals.maxSize = 40 * 1024^3)
plan("multicore")

# Standard workflow: normalization, feature selection, scaling, PCA, UMAP
sc_seurat <- sc_seurat %>%
  NormalizeData() %>%
  FindVariableFeatures(selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000) %>%
  ScaleData() %>%
  RunPCA() %>%
  RunUMAP(dims = 1:30)

DimPlot(sc_seurat, split.by = "Genotype")
ggsave(filename = file.path(plotdir, "UMAP_post-filter_pre_doublet_removal.pdf"), width = 30, height = 15, units = "cm")

# Doublet detection with DoubletFinder
# Split by genotype, run DoubletFinder on each subset, then merge back

seurat_list <- SplitObject(sc_seurat, split.by = "Genotype")

doublet_dir <- file.path(plotdir, "DoubletFinder")
dir.create(doublet_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

doublet_metrics <- list()

for (i in seq_along(seurat_list)) {
  sample_name <- names(seurat_list)[i]
  message("Processing sample: ", sample_name)
  
  DefaultAssay(seurat_list[[i]]) <- "RNA"
  
  # Find neighbors/clusters
  seurat_list[[i]] <- FindNeighbors(seurat_list[[i]], dims = 1:30)
  seurat_list[[i]] <- FindClusters(seurat_list[[i]], resolution = 0.4)
  
  # Parameter sweep
  sweep.res <- paramSweep(seurat_list[[i]], PCs = 1:30, sct = FALSE)
  sweep.stats <- summarizeSweep(sweep.res, GT = FALSE)
  bcmvn <- find.pK(sweep.stats)
  
  # Optimal pK
  optimal.pK <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric), "pK"]))
  
  # Homotypic doublet proportion
  annotations <- seurat_list[[i]]@meta.data$seurat_clusters
  homotypic.prop <- modelHomotypic(annotations)
  
  # Number of expected doublets (default 5%; adjust as needed)
  nExp_poi <- round(ncol(seurat_list[[i]]) * 0.05)
  nExp_poi.adj <- round(nExp_poi * (1 - homotypic.prop))
  
  # Run DoubletFinder
  seurat_list[[i]] <- doubletFinder(
    seurat_list[[i]],
    PCs = 1:30,
    pN = 0.25,
    pK = optimal.pK,
    nExp = nExp_poi.adj,
    reuse.pANN = FALSE,
    sct = FALSE
  )
  
  # Identify the classification column from DoubletFinder
  classification_col <- grep("^DF.classifications_", 
                             colnames(seurat_list[[i]]@meta.data), 
                             value = TRUE)
  
  # Visualize doublets vs. singlets
  DimPlot(seurat_list[[i]], reduction = "umap", group.by = classification_col) +
    ggtitle(paste0("DoubletFinder Results: ", sample_name)) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
  ggsave(filename = file.path(doublet_dir, paste0(sample_name, "_DoubletFinder_UMAP.pdf")),
         width = 10, height = 8)
  
  # Collect metrics
  total_cells <- ncol(seurat_list[[i]])
  doublet_count <- sum(seurat_list[[i]]@meta.data[[classification_col]] == "Doublet")
  singlet_count <- sum(seurat_list[[i]]@meta.data[[classification_col]] == "Singlet")
  
  doublet_metrics[[sample_name]] <- data.frame(
    Sample = sample_name,
    Total_Cells = total_cells,
    Expected_Doublets = nExp_poi,
    Adjusted_Expected_Doublets = nExp_poi.adj,
    Doublet_Count = doublet_count,
    Singlet_Count = singlet_count
  )
  
  # Keep only singlets
  singlet_cells <- rownames(
    seurat_list[[i]]@meta.data[
      seurat_list[[i]]@meta.data[[classification_col]] == "Singlet", ]
  )
  seurat_list[[i]] <- subset(seurat_list[[i]], cells = singlet_cells)
  
  # Optionally remove other assays to reduce object size
  seurat_list[[i]] <- DietSeurat(seurat_list[[i]], assays = "RNA")
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Merge cleaned samples back together
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
sc_seurat <- merge(seurat_list[[1]], y = seurat_list[-1])
sc_seurat <- JoinLayers(sc_seurat)  # if needed for Seurat layering

# Combine doublet metrics into a single data frame
metrics_df <- do.call(rbind, doublet_metrics)

# Save metrics to CSV
write.csv(metrics_df,
          file = file.path(doublet_dir, "DoubletFinder_Metrics_All_Samples.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

# Re-run standard workflow after doublet removal

sc_seurat <- sc_seurat %>%
  NormalizeData() %>%
  FindVariableFeatures(selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000) %>%
  ScaleData() %>%
  RunPCA() %>%
  RunUMAP(dims = 1:30) %>%
  FindNeighbors(dims = 1:30) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.5)

DimPlot(sc_seurat, split.by = "Genotype")
ggsave(filename = file.path(plotdir, "UMAP_post-filter_post_doublet_removal.pdf"), width = 30, height = 15, units = "cm")

# Run Azimuth
DefaultAssay(sc_seurat) <- "RNA"
sc_seurat <- NormalizeData(sc_seurat) 
sc_seurat <- Azimuth::RunAzimuth(sc_seurat, reference = "mousecortexref")

saveRDS(sc_seurat, file = file.path(work_dir,"scNeuroD_DKO_2025_doublet_Removed_azimuth.rds"))

```

```{r recovery_independent_composition}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

DKO <- "NeuroD2_D6DKO"; WT_LAB <- "WT"

# =============================================================================
# Reviewer 6: demonstrate the L6B/L5 expansion and L6 reduction are NOT explained
# by uneven cell recovery. Proportions are within-genotype fractions, so the 2x
# cell-count difference is normalized out by construction. If recovery were the
# only difference, all clusters would shift by the SAME factor (uniform). We show
# the shifts are DISPROPORTIONATE — some clusters up, some down — which uneven
# recovery cannot produce.
# =============================================================================

tot <- sc_seurat@meta.data %>% dplyr::count(Genotype, name = "total")
tot_WT  <- tot$total[tot$Genotype == WT_LAB]
tot_DKO <- tot$total[tot$Genotype == DKO]

layer_focus <- c("Layer V", "Layer VI", "Layer VIb",
                 "Misspecified UL", "Misspecified DL")

comp_layers <- sc_seurat@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::filter(cluster_named %in% layer_focus) %>%
  dplyr::count(cluster_named, Genotype, name = "n_cells") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Genotype, values_from = n_cells, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(
    prop_WT   = .data[[WT_LAB]] / tot_WT,
    prop_DKO  = .data[[DKO]]    / tot_DKO,
    pct_WT    = round(100 * prop_WT, 3),
    pct_DKO   = round(100 * prop_DKO, 3),
    fold_change = round(prop_DKO / (prop_WT + 1e-6), 2),   # proportion fold-change
    log2_ratio  = round(log2((prop_DKO + 1e-4) / (prop_WT + 1e-4)), 2)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(log2_ratio))
print(comp_layers)
write.table(comp_layers, "Revision_layer_composition_recovery_independent.csv",
            sep = ",", row.names = FALSE)

# =============================================================================
# The KEY argument: if uneven recovery were the explanation, every cluster's
# DKO/WT proportion fold-change would be ~1 (proportions are already recovery-
# normalized). Show the SPREAD of fold-changes — divergence from 1 in BOTH
# directions = genuine compositional change, not a recovery artifact.
# =============================================================================
all_comp <- sc_seurat@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::count(cluster_named, Genotype, name = "n_cells") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Genotype, values_from = n_cells, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(prop_WT  = .data[[WT_LAB]] / tot_WT,
         prop_DKO = .data[[DKO]]    / tot_DKO,
         log2_ratio = log2((prop_DKO + 1e-4) / (prop_WT + 1e-4)))

cat("\n--- Recovery-independence check ---\n")
cat("If uneven recovery were the sole cause, all log2 proportion-ratios ≈ 0.\n")
cat("Observed range of log2 ratios:",
    round(min(all_comp$log2_ratio), 2), "to",
    round(max(all_comp$log2_ratio), 2), "\n")
cat("Clusters ENRICHED in DKO (log2 ratio > 0.5):",
    sum(all_comp$log2_ratio > 0.5), "\n")
cat("Clusters DEPLETED in DKO (log2 ratio < -0.5):",
    sum(all_comp$log2_ratio < -0.5), "\n")
cat("-> Shifts occur in BOTH directions: incompatible with uniform recovery bias.\n\n")

# =============================================================================
# Focused plot: the deep-layer clusters the reviewer names, WT vs DKO proportions
# =============================================================================
plot_df <- comp_layers %>%
  dplyr::select(cluster_named, pct_WT, pct_DKO) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(c(pct_WT, pct_DKO), names_to = "Genotype", values_to = "pct") %>%
  mutate(Genotype = ifelse(Genotype == "pct_WT", "WT", "DKO"),
         Genotype = factor(Genotype, levels = c("WT", "DKO")))

dir.create("plots/revision/proportions", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = cluster_named, y = pct, fill = Genotype)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("WT" = "grey70", "DKO" = "firebrick")) +
  labs(y = "% of genotype's cells (recovery-normalized)", x = NULL,
       title = "Deep-layer composition: WT vs DKO (within-genotype proportions)",
       subtitle = "Proportions normalize out the 2x recovery difference") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1))
ggsave("plots/revision/proportions/deeplayer_recovery_independent.pdf", p,
       width = 7, height = 5)

message("Recovery-independence analysis complete.")
```


```{r plot_functions}

# Function to generate FeaturePlots for a list of genes and save each plot
save_feature_plots <- function(seurat_obj, genes, plotdir, reduction = "ref.umap", assay = "RNA") {
  # Ensure the directory exists
  if (!dir.exists(plotdir)) dir.create(plotdir, recursive = TRUE)
  
  # Set default assay
  DefaultAssay(seurat_obj) <- assay
  
  # Loop through each gene and generate FeaturePlot
  for (gene in genes) {
    # Generate the plot
    plot <- FeaturePlot(seurat_obj, 
                        reduction = reduction, 
                        order = TRUE, 
                        features = gene, 
                        coord.fixed = TRUE,
                        pt.size = 0.1
                        ) +
    scale_color_gradient(low = "lightblue", high = "darkblue") +
    xlab("UMAP 1")+
    ylab("UMAP 2")
    # Save the plot to a PDF file
    file_name <- paste0(plotdir, "/", gene, "_expression_all_", reduction, ".pdf")
    ggsave(file_name, plot = plot, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300)
    
    # Print a message for progress tracking
    message("Saved FeaturePlot for gene: ", gene)
  }
}

save_feature_plots_split <- function(seurat_obj, genes, plotdir, reduction = "ref.umap", assay = "RNA") {
  # Ensure the directory exists
  if (!dir.exists(plotdir)) dir.create(plotdir, recursive = TRUE)
  
  # Set default assay
  DefaultAssay(seurat_obj) <- assay
  
  # Loop through each gene and generate FeaturePlot
  for (gene in genes) {
    # Generate the plot
    plot <- FeaturePlot(seurat_obj, 
                        reduction = reduction, 
                        split.by = "Genotype",
                        order = TRUE, 
                        features = gene,
                        pt.size = 0.1,
                        cols = c("lightblue","darkblue"),
                        coord.fixed = TRUE
                        ) +
    theme(
        legend.position = "right",  # Ensure the legend is shown
        legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8)
    )+
    xlab("UMAP 1")+
    ylab("UMAP 2")
    # Save the plot to a PDF file
    file_name <- paste0(plotdir, "/", gene,  "_expression_all_split_by_genotype_", reduction, ".pdf")
    ggsave(file_name, plot = plot, width = 12, height = 5, dpi = 300)
    
    # Print a message for progress tracking
    message("Saved FeaturePlot Split for gene: ", gene)
  }
}
```

```{r DEresults}
# =============================================================================
# Between-genotype comparison — n=1 per genotype. DESCRIPTIVE pseudobulk log2FC,
# for ranking and visualization only (no valid p-values at n=1).
#
# Misspecified clusters (no WT cells): contrast = ONE-VS-REST. Each Misspecified
# (DKO) cluster is compared against ALL OTHER cells in the dataset. This is a
# marker-style contrast answering "what is the transcriptional identity of these
# aberrant cells relative to the whole cortex?" — used CONSISTENTLY across all
# downstream analyses (heatmaps, GSEA). NOTE: shared clusters remain DKO-vs-WT
# within celltype; the Misspecified columns are marker enrichment, a different
# quantity, and must be captioned as such.
# =============================================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(purrr)

DKO       <- "NeuroD2_D6DKO"
WT_LAB    <- "WT"
DKO_CLEAN <- gsub("_", "-", DKO)

PRIVATE_CLUSTERS <- c("Misspecified UL", "Misspecified DL")  # DKO-only

# ---- Pseudobulk DKO-vs-WT log2FC for one cell grouping (shared clusters) ----
pseudobulk_log2fc <- function(seurat_obj, group_label, group_col = "cluster_named",
                              min_cells = 20, pseudocount = 1) {
  if (is.null(group_label)) {
    sub <- seurat_obj
  } else {
    sub <- seurat_obj[, seurat_obj@meta.data[[group_col]] == group_label]
  }
  n_per <- table(sub@meta.data[["Genotype"]])
  if (!all(c(WT_LAB, DKO) %in% names(n_per)) ||
      any(n_per[c(WT_LAB, DKO)] < min_cells)) {
    message("  log2FC skip '", group_label %||% "ALL",
            "' (<", min_cells, " cells in a genotype)")
    return(NULL)
  }
  agg <- AggregateExpression(sub, assays = "RNA", slot = "counts",
                             group.by = "Genotype",
                             return.seurat = FALSE)$RNA |> as.matrix()
  if (!all(c(WT_LAB, DKO_CLEAN) %in% colnames(agg))) return(NULL)
  cpm <- sweep(agg, 2, colSums(agg), "/") * 1e6
  data.frame(
    gene       = rownames(cpm),
    cpm_WT     = cpm[, WT_LAB],
    cpm_DKO    = cpm[, DKO_CLEAN],
    n_WT       = as.integer(n_per[WT_LAB]),
    n_DKO      = as.integer(n_per[DKO]),
    avg_log2FC = log2((cpm[, DKO_CLEAN] + pseudocount) /
                        (cpm[, WT_LAB] + pseudocount)),
    mean_cpm   = (cpm[, DKO_CLEAN] + cpm[, WT_LAB]) / 2,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
}

# ---- Pseudobulk: Misspecified cluster vs ALL OTHER cells (one-vs-rest) ----
# Returns the SAME column shape as pseudobulk_log2fc(). `cpm_WT` column slot holds
# the "Rest" (all other cells) reference; `cpm_DKO` holds the Misspecified cluster.
misspec_vs_rest <- function(seurat_obj, misspec_cluster,
                            min_cells = 20, pseudocount = 1) {
  md <- seurat_obj@meta.data
  is_misspec <- md$cluster_named == misspec_cluster   # cluster is DKO-only anyway
  is_rest    <- md$cluster_named != misspec_cluster   # everything else

  n_misspec <- sum(is_misspec)
  n_rest    <- sum(is_rest)
  if (n_misspec < min_cells || n_rest < min_cells) {
    message("  Misspec(vs-rest) skip '", misspec_cluster, "' (",
            n_misspec, " misspec / ", n_rest, " rest cells; need >=", min_cells, ")")
    return(NULL)
  }

  sub <- seurat_obj
  sub$compare_grp <- ifelse(sub@meta.data$cluster_named == misspec_cluster,
                            "Misspecified", "Rest")

  agg <- AggregateExpression(sub, assays = "RNA", slot = "counts",
                             group.by = "compare_grp",
                             return.seurat = FALSE)$RNA |> as.matrix()
  if (!all(c("Misspecified", "Rest") %in% colnames(agg))) return(NULL)

  cpm <- sweep(agg, 2, colSums(agg), "/") * 1e6
  data.frame(
    gene       = rownames(cpm),
    cpm_WT     = cpm[, "Rest"],                        # reference = all other cells
    cpm_DKO    = cpm[, "Misspecified"],
    n_WT       = as.integer(n_rest),
    n_DKO      = as.integer(n_misspec),
    avg_log2FC = log2((cpm[, "Misspecified"] + pseudocount) /
                        (cpm[, "Rest"] + pseudocount)),
    mean_cpm   = (cpm[, "Misspecified"] + cpm[, "Rest"]) / 2,
    cluster_named = misspec_cluster,
    comparison = "Misspec_vs_Rest",
    check.names = FALSE
  )
}

# ---- All cells together ----
DE <- pseudobulk_log2fc(sc_seurat, group_label = NULL)
write.table(DE, file = "Differential_genes_All_cells_DKO_vs_WT.csv",
            sep = ",", row.names = FALSE)

# ---- Per shared cluster (genotype-private clusters excluded: no WT cells) ----
all_clusters    <- as.character(unique(sc_seurat$cluster_named))
shared_clusters <- setdiff(all_clusters, PRIVATE_CLUSTERS)

DE_results <- map(shared_clusters, function(cl) {
  res <- pseudobulk_log2fc(sc_seurat, group_label = cl)
  if (!is.null(res)) res$cluster_named <- cl
  res
})
names(DE_results) <- shared_clusters

DE_combined <- DE_results %>%
  purrr::compact() %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows()
DE_combined$comparison <- "DKO_vs_WT"

# =============================================================================
# Add Misspecified clusters via ONE-VS-REST (vs all other cells).
# Marker-style contrast; same CPM-log2FC computation so it slots into the table,
# but interpretation differs from the shared DKO-vs-WT columns (see header note).
# =============================================================================
private_rows <- map(PRIVATE_CLUSTERS, function(mc) {
  misspec_vs_rest(sc_seurat, mc)
}) %>%
  purrr::compact() %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows()

DE_combined_all <- bind_rows(DE_combined, private_rows)

write.table(DE_combined_all,
            file = "Revision_Genotype_changes_DKO_vs_WT_ALL_clusters.csv",
            sep = ",", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r heatmap}
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(purrr)
library(Matrix)

# =============================================================================
# Genes selected per scope. Shared rows gated by DKO-vs-WT log2FC + CPM +
# detection specificity; Misspecified rows gated by their ONE-VS-REST log2FC + CPM.
# NOTE: Misspecified columns are marker-style (vs all other cells), a different
# quantity from the shared DKO-vs-WT columns — caption accordingly.
# =============================================================================

FORCE_GENES <- c("Eomes","Crtac1","Dpf3","Hrk","Sorcs1","Sorcs3")

DKO_LAB <- "NeuroD2_D6DKO"
WT_LAB  <- "WT"

# Cell-level detection guard (shared clusters only; pooled DKO-vs-WT detection diff)
shared_all_clusters <- setdiff(as.character(unique(sc_seurat$cluster_named)),
                               PRIVATE_CLUSTERS)
pyr_for_detect <- subset(sc_seurat, subset = cluster_named %in% shared_all_clusters)
expr_bin <- GetAssayData(pyr_for_detect, layer = "counts") > 0
geno     <- pyr_for_detect$Genotype
detect_df <- data.frame(
  gene        = rownames(pyr_for_detect),
  pct_WT      = Matrix::rowMeans(expr_bin[, geno == WT_LAB]),
  pct_DKO     = Matrix::rowMeans(expr_bin[, geno == DKO_LAB]),
  row.names   = NULL
) %>% mutate(specificity = pct_DKO - pct_WT)

# =============================================================================
# GENE SELECTION — shared via DKO-vs-WT cutoffs; Misspecified via one-vs-rest FC.
# =============================================================================
select_top_genes <- function(de_table, scope_clusters,
                             shared_fc, shared_cpm, shared_spec,
                             private_fc, private_cpm) {
  tbl <- de_table %>%
    filter(cluster_named %in% scope_clusters) %>%
    left_join(detect_df, by = "gene")

  shared_hits <- tbl %>%
    filter(comparison == "DKO_vs_WT",
           abs(avg_log2FC)  > shared_fc,
           mean_cpm         > shared_cpm,
           abs(specificity) > shared_spec) %>%
    pull(gene)

  # Misspecified: one-vs-rest marker log2FC, gated by FC + expression floor.
  private_hits <- tbl %>%
    filter(comparison == "Misspec_vs_Rest",
           abs(avg_log2FC) > private_fc,
           mean_cpm        > private_cpm) %>%
    pull(gene)

  unique(c(shared_hits, private_hits, intersect(FORCE_GENES, de_table$gene)))
}

)

LABEL_GENES <- unique(c(
  "Nr4a2","Rorb","Neurod1","Satb2","Bcl11b","Fezf2","Unc5d","Cux2","Cux1",

render_cell_heatmap <- function(genes, scope_clusters, file, title,
                                width = 8, height = 10, label_every = NULL) {
  sub <- subset(sc_seurat, subset = cluster_named %in% scope_clusters)
  sub$cluster_named <- factor(sub$cluster_named, levels = scope_clusters)
  DefaultAssay(sub) <- "RNA"
  sub <- ScaleData(sub, features = genes, verbose = FALSE)

  mat <- GetAssayData(sub, layer = "scale.data")
  mat <- mat[intersect(rownames(mat), genes), , drop = FALSE]

  ann <- sub@meta.data[colnames(mat), c("cluster_named", "Genotype")]
  ann$Genotype <- factor(ann$Genotype, levels = c(WT_LAB, DKO_LAB))
  ann$cluster_named <- factor(ann$cluster_named, levels = scope_clusters)
  ord <- order(ann$cluster_named, ann$Genotype)
  mat <- mat[, ord]; ann <- ann[ord, ]

  sub_cols <- setNames(rainbow(nlevels(ann$cluster_named)),
                       levels(ann$cluster_named))
  col_ann <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    Genotype = ann$Genotype, Celltype = ann$cluster_named,
    col = list(Genotype = c("WT" = "grey80", "NeuroD2_D6DKO" = "firebrick"),
               Celltype = sub_cols)
  )

  curated_idx <- which(rownames(mat) %in% LABEL_GENES)
  if (!is.null(label_every) && label_every > 0) {
    step_idx <- seq(1, nrow(mat), by = label_every)
    mark_idx <- sort(unique(c(step_idx, curated_idx)))
  } else {
    mark_idx <- sort(curated_idx)
  }
  mark_labels <- rownames(mat)[mark_idx]

  gene_labels <- rowAnnotation(
    Genes = anno_mark(
      at = mark_idx, labels = mark_labels,
      labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9, fontface = "italic"), padding = 0.5
    )
  )

  h <- Heatmap(mat, name = "Scaled Expression", top_annotation = col_ann,
               show_row_names = FALSE, show_column_names = FALSE,
               cluster_rows = TRUE, column_split = ann$cluster_named,
               cluster_columns = FALSE, column_title = title, row_title = "Top Genes",
               row_gap = unit(0.5, "mm"), column_gap = unit(0.5, "mm"),
               clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2", use_raster = TRUE,
               col = colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2), c("blue", "white", "red")),
               heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "Scaled Expression"))

  pdf(file, width = width, height = height)
  draw(h + gene_labels)
  dev.off()
  message("Wrote ", file, " (", nrow(mat), " genes, ", length(mark_idx), " labeled)")
}

# avg-log2FC heatmap. Shared columns = DKO-vs-WT; Misspecified = one-vs-rest.
render_logfc_heatmap <- function(genes, scope_clusters, file, title,
                                 width = 6, height = 10) {
  mat <- DE_combined_all %>%
    dplyr::filter(gene %in% genes, cluster_named %in% scope_clusters) %>%
    dplyr::select(gene, cluster = cluster_named, value = avg_log2FC) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = cluster, values_from = value) %>%
    column_to_rownames("gene") %>%
    as.matrix()
  mat[is.na(mat)] <- 0

  present <- intersect(scope_clusters, colnames(mat))
  mat <- mat[, present, drop = FALSE]

  col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(min(mat), 0, max(mat)), c("blue", "white", "red"))
  h <- Heatmap(mat, name = "log2FC", col = col_fun,
               cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_columns = FALSE,
               row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9), column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
               heatmap_legend_param = list(
                 title = "log2FC",
                 at = c(round(min(mat), 2), 0, round(max(mat), 2)),
                 labels = c(round(min(mat), 2), "0", round(max(mat), 2))),
               column_title = title, column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11, fontface = "bold"))
  pdf(file, width = width, height = height); draw(h); dev.off()
  message("Wrote ", file, " (", nrow(mat), " genes)")
}
```

```{r Generate_GSEA_results}
library(Seurat)
library(fgsea)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)

dir.create("plots/revision/GSEA", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("plots/revision/GSEA/Genes_by_cluster", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# =============================================================================
# GSEA ranked on PER-CELL FindMarkers log2FC (continuous -> no ties).
# - Shared clusters: per-cell FindMarkers(DKO vs WT) log2FC
# - Misspecified clusters: per-cell FindMarkers(Misspecified vs ALL OTHER cells)
#   log2FC — ONE-VS-REST, consistent with the heatmap/DE contrast.
# SCOPE: neuronal clusters (pyramidal lineage + interneurons). Cycling BP incl.
# =============================================================================

DKO <- "NeuroD2_D6DKO"; WT_LAB <- "WT"
MIN_CELLS_GSEA <- 3

INTERNEURON_CLUSTERS <- c("Interneuron I", "Interneuron II", "Interneuron III")
PYRAMID_LINEAGE   <- unique(c(pyramid_all, "Cycling BP"))
NEURONAL_CLUSTERS <- unique(c(PYRAMID_LINEAGE, INTERNEURON_CLUSTERS))
gsea_clusters <- intersect(NEURONAL_CLUSTERS,
                           unique(as.character(sc_seurat$cluster_named)))
PRIVATE_CLUSTERS <- c("Misspecified UL", "Misspecified DL")

message("GSEA neuronal clusters: ", paste(gsea_clusters, collapse = ", "))

# ---- Shared cluster: per-cell FindMarkers DKO vs WT ----
ranks_dko_vs_wt <- function(seurat_obj, clust) {
  sub <- subset(seurat_obj, subset = cluster_named == clust)
  Idents(sub) <- "Genotype"
  cc <- table(Idents(sub))
  if (!all(c(DKO, WT_LAB) %in% names(cc)) || any(cc[c(DKO, WT_LAB)] < MIN_CELLS_GSEA)) {
    message("  GSEA skip '", clust, "' (insufficient cells per genotype)")
    return(numeric(0))
  }
  FindMarkers(sub, ident.1 = DKO, ident.2 = WT_LAB,
              logfc.threshold = 0, min.pct = 0) %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    dplyr::select(gene, avg_log2FC) %>%
    filter(!is.na(avg_log2FC)) %>%
    arrange(desc(avg_log2FC)) %>%
    deframe()
}

# ---- Misspecified: per-cell FindMarkers vs ALL OTHER cells (one-vs-rest) ----
ranks_misspec <- function(seurat_obj, misspec_cluster) {
  Idents(seurat_obj) <- "cluster_named"
  n_mis <- sum(seurat_obj$cluster_named == misspec_cluster)
  if (n_mis < MIN_CELLS_GSEA) {
    message("  GSEA skip '", misspec_cluster, "' (too few cells)")
    return(numeric(0))
  }
  # ident.1 = the Misspecified cluster; ident.2 = NULL -> all other cells
  FindMarkers(seurat_obj, ident.1 = misspec_cluster, ident.2 = NULL,
              logfc.threshold = 0, min.pct = 0) %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    dplyr::select(gene, avg_log2FC) %>%
    filter(!is.na(avg_log2FC)) %>%
    arrange(desc(avg_log2FC)) %>%
    deframe()
}

tie_frac <- function(x) if (length(x) == 0) NA else mean(duplicated(x) | duplicated(x, fromLast = TRUE))

gsea_results <- list()
for (clust in gsea_clusters) {
  ranks <- if (clust %in% PRIVATE_CLUSTERS) {
    ranks_misspec(sc_seurat, clust)
  } else {
    ranks_dko_vs_wt(sc_seurat, clust)
  }
  if (length(ranks) < 50) next
  message(sprintf("GSEA '%s': %d genes, %.1f%% tied", clust, length(ranks),
                  100 * tie_frac(ranks)))
  res <- tryCatch(
    gseGO(geneList = ranks, OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db, ont = "BP",
          nPermSimple = 10000, eps = 0, keyType = "SYMBOL", verbose = FALSE),
    error = function(e) { message("  GSEA error '", clust, "': ", e$message); NULL }
  )
  if (!is.null(res)) gsea_results[[clust]] <- res
}

# ---- Pooled all-cells GSEA (per-cell DKO vs WT) ----
Idents(sc_seurat) <- "Genotype"
ranks_all <- FindMarkers(sc_seurat, ident.1 = DKO, ident.2 = WT_LAB,
                         logfc.threshold = 0, min.pct = 0) %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, avg_log2FC) %>%
  filter(!is.na(avg_log2FC)) %>%
  arrange(desc(avg_log2FC)) %>%
  deframe()
message(sprintf("GSEA 'all': %d genes, %.1f%% tied", length(ranks_all),
                100 * tie_frac(ranks_all)))
gsea_results[["all"]] <- tryCatch(
  gseGO(geneList = ranks_all, OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db, ont = "BP",
        nPermSimple = 10000, eps = 0, keyType = "SYMBOL", verbose = FALSE),
  error = function(e) { message("  GSEA error 'all': ", e$message); NULL }
)

gsea_results <- purrr::compact(gsea_results)
message("GSEA completed for: ", paste(names(gsea_results), collapse = ", "))

get_gsea_df <- function(gsea_obj) {
  if (inherits(gsea_obj, "gseaResult")) return(gsea_obj@result)
  return(gsea_obj)
}
```

```{r plotGSEA}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)

# =============================================================================
# GSEA summary figures, generated per scope (all-neuronal, pyramidal).
# Scopes match the GSEA chunk (gsea_clusters / PYRAMID_LINEAGE), NOT the heatmap
# scopes — so Cycling BP lands in PYRAMIDS and only clusters GSEA actually ran are
# plotted.
#
# Tileplot DISPLAY metric = pseudobulk log2FC from DE_combined_all (shared =
# DKO-vs-WT; Misspecified = ONE-VS-REST vs all other cells, both genotypes). This
# INTENTIONALLY differs from the GSEA RANKING metric (per-cell FindMarkers):
# ranking uses continuous per-cell log2FC (tie-free), display uses pseudobulk for
# consistency with the heatmaps.
# =============================================================================

PRIVATE_CLUSTERS <- c("Misspecified UL", "Misspecified DL")

scope_clusters <- list(
  ALL_NEURONAL = intersect(c(gsea_clusters, "all"),  names(gsea_results)),
  PYRAMIDS     = intersect(c(PYRAMID_LINEAGE, "all"), names(gsea_results))
)

logfc_for_genes <- function(de_table, genes, clusters, all_cells_DE) {
  shared <- de_table %>%
    filter(gene %in% genes, cluster_named %in% setdiff(clusters, "all")) %>%
    dplyr::select(gene, avg_log2FC, cluster = cluster_named)
  if ("all" %in% clusters && !is.null(all_cells_DE)) {
    pooled <- all_cells_DE %>%
      filter(gene %in% genes) %>%
      dplyr::select(gene, avg_log2FC) %>%
      mutate(cluster = "all")
    shared <- bind_rows(shared, pooled)
  }
  shared
}

run_gsea_plots <- function(scope_name, clusters_in_scope) {

  gdir <- file.path("plots/revision/GSEA", scope_name)
  tdir <- file.path(gdir, "Genes_by_cluster")
  dir.create(tdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  results_in_scope <- purrr::compact(gsea_results[clusters_in_scope])
  if (length(results_in_scope) == 0) {
    message("No GSEA results in scope ", scope_name); return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  plot_data <- imap_dfr(results_in_scope, function(obj, cl) {
    get_gsea_df(obj) %>%
      filter(!is.na(p.adjust), !is.na(NES)) %>%
      arrange(p.adjust) %>% slice_head(n = 10) %>%
      mutate(cluster = cl)
  })

  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) {
    message("No enriched terms to plot for scope ", scope_name)
  } else {
    top_terms_dot <- unique(plot_data$Description)
    df.gseGO <- plot_data %>%
      filter(Description %in% top_terms_dot) %>%
      dplyr::select(Description, cluster, NES, p.adjust) %>%
      mutate(logFDR = -log10(p.adjust)) %>%
      mutate(Description = factor(Description,
               levels = rev(names(sort(table(Description), decreasing = TRUE)))))

    p_dot <- ggplot(df.gseGO, aes(x = cluster, y = Description)) +
      geom_point(aes(size = logFDR, color = NES)) +
      scale_color_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", midpoint = 0) +
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(x = "Cluster", y = "GO:BP Term", size = "-log10(FDR)", color = "NES",
           title = paste0("GSEA (GO:BP) - ", scope_name,
                          "  [Misspecified = vs rest (all other cells)]")) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
    ggsave(file.path(gdir, paste0("GSEA_dotplot_", scope_name, ".pdf")),
           plot = p_dot, width = 8.5, height = 9)
  }

  top_terms <- imap_dfr(results_in_scope, ~ get_gsea_df(.x) %>%
                          filter(!is.na(p.adjust)) %>%
                          arrange(p.adjust) %>% slice_head(n = 80) %>%
                          dplyr::select(Description)) %>%
    distinct(Description) %>% pull(Description)

  if (length(top_terms) == 0) {
    message("No terms for tileplots in scope ", scope_name); return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  term_to_clusters <- imap_dfr(results_in_scope, function(obj, cluster) {
    df <- get_gsea_df(obj)
    if (!"Description" %in% colnames(df)) return(NULL)
    df %>% filter(Description %in% top_terms) %>% distinct(Description) %>%
      mutate(cluster = cluster)
  }) %>% group_by(Description) %>%
    summarise(clusters = paste(sort(unique(cluster)), collapse = ", "),
              .groups = "drop")

  term_genes <- map_dfr(top_terms, function(term) {
    for (cl in names(results_in_scope)) {
      gdf <- get_gsea_df(results_in_scope[[cl]])
      if (!"core_enrichment" %in% colnames(gdf)) next
      row <- gdf %>% filter(Description == term)
      if (nrow(row) == 0) next
      ce <- row$core_enrichment[1]
      if (is.na(ce) || ce == "") next
      genes <- head(strsplit(ce, "/")[[1]], 50)
      return(tibble(Description = term, gene = genes))
    }
    NULL
  })
  if (nrow(term_genes) == 0) {
    message("No core-enrichment genes for scope ", scope_name); return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  genes_to_check <- unique(term_genes$gene)
  logfc_table <- logfc_for_genes(DE_combined_all, genes_to_check,
                                 clusters_in_scope, DE)

  term_logfc_data <- term_genes %>%
    left_join(logfc_table, by = "gene", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
    filter(!is.na(avg_log2FC))

  if (nrow(term_logfc_data) == 0) {
    message("No log2FC matches for tileplots in scope ", scope_name)
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  tile_size <- 0.3
  for (term in unique(term_logfc_data$Description)) {
    plot_df <- term_logfc_data %>% filter(Description == term)

    gene_order <- plot_df %>% group_by(gene) %>%
      summarise(score = mean(abs(avg_log2FC), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      arrange(desc(score)) %>% pull(gene)

    plot_df <- plot_df %>%
      mutate(cluster = factor(cluster, levels = sort(unique(cluster))),
             gene    = factor(gene, levels = gene_order))

    n_genes    <- length(unique(plot_df$gene))
    n_clusters <- length(unique(plot_df$cluster))
    if (n_genes < 2 || n_clusters < 2) next

    cluster_note <- term_to_clusters %>% filter(Description == term) %>% pull(clusters)
    if (length(cluster_note) == 0) cluster_note <- "Unknown"
    full_title <- paste0("GO:BP ", term, "\n(Enriched in: ", cluster_note, ")")

    p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = gene, y = cluster, fill = avg_log2FC)) +
      geom_tile(color = "white") +
      scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", midpoint = 0) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
      labs(title = full_title, x = "Gene", y = "Cluster", fill = "avg log2FC") +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
            axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
            plot.title  = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
            plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)) +
      coord_fixed(ratio = 1)

    suppressWarnings(
      ggsave(file.path(tdir, paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", term), "_tileplot.pdf")),
             plot = p, width = n_genes * tile_size + 3,
             height = n_clusters * tile_size + 2, units = "in")
    )
  }
  message("Wrote GSEA plots for scope: ", scope_name)
}

run_gsea_plots("ALL_NEURONAL", scope_clusters$ALL_NEURONAL)
run_gsea_plots("PYRAMIDS",     scope_clusters$PYRAMIDS)
```

```{r leading_edge}
library(clusterProfiler)
library(enrichplot)
library(ggplot2)

dir.create("plots/revision/GSEA/leading_edge", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Misspecified clusters now ranked vs REST (all other cells) — this contrast is
# expected to surface the broad developmental program. Look for those terms.
LE_SOURCES <- intersect(c("Misspecified UL", "Misspecified DL"), names(gsea_results))



terms_of_interest <- c(
  "forebrain development",
  "positive regulation of cell adhesion",
  "regulation of Wnt signaling pathway",
  "Wnt signaling pathway",
  "regulation of neuron differentiation",
  "regulation of cell cycle phase transition",
  "neuronal stem cell population maintenance",
  "regulation of neurogenesis",
  "regulation of BMP signaling pathway",
  "positive regulation of Notch signaling pathway",
  "cell proliferation in forebrain",
  "regulation of synaptic transmission, glutamatergic",
  "regulation of neuron differentiation",
  "stem cell population maintenance",          # corrected spelling
  "regulation of neuronal synaptic plasticity"
)

for (src in LE_SOURCES) {
  gsea_obj <- gsea_results[[src]]
  gsea_df  <- get_gsea_df(gsea_obj)
  available_terms <- gsea_df$Description[gsea_df$Description %in% terms_of_interest]
  src_tag <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", src)

  if (length(available_terms) == 0)
    message("None of terms_of_interest present in ", src,
            " — inspect get_gsea_df(gsea_results[['", src, "']]) for actual term names")

  for (term in available_terms) {
    term_id <- gsea_df$ID[gsea_df$Description == term][1]
    p <- gseaplot2(gsea_obj, geneSetID = term_id, title = paste0(term, " - ", src))
    ggsave(file.path("plots/revision/GSEA/leading_edge",
                     paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", term), "_", src_tag, "_gseaplot2.pdf")),
           plot = p, width = 7, height = 6)
  }

  # ---- Combined leading-edge plot (only terms that actually exist) ----
  terms_to_plot <- intersect(
    c("pattern specification process", "cell-cell signaling by Wnt",
      "regulation of synaptic transmission, glutamatergic",
      "regulation of neuron differentiation"),
    gsea_df$Description)
  if (length(terms_to_plot) == 0) {
    message("No combined-plot terms found for ", src); next
  }
  term_ids <- vapply(terms_to_plot,
                     function(t) gsea_df$ID[gsea_df$Description == t][1], character(1))
  term_colors <- c("#1A5354", "firebrick", "#F79D1E", "blue")[seq_along(terms_to_plot)]

  combined_plot <- gseaplot2(
    gsea_obj, geneSetID = term_ids,
    title = paste0("GSEA in ", src, " cells (vs rest)"),
    pvalue_table = TRUE, base_size = 18, subplots = 1:2,
    rel_heights = c(1, 0.3), color = term_colors)
  ggsave(file.path("plots/revision/GSEA/leading_edge",
                   paste0("combined_leading_edge_", src_tag, ".pdf")),
         plot = combined_plot, width = 12, height = 8)
}
```

```{r enrichGO}
################### ORA by enrichGO — gene sets defined by PSEUDOBULK EFFECT SIZE
# NOT per-cell FindMarkers p-values (invalid at n=1). Genes selected by
# |pseudobulk log2FC| from DE_combined_all; up/down by sign. Shared clusters =
# DKO-vs-WT; Misspecified clusters = ONE-VS-REST (vs all other cells, both
# genotypes). ORA on strong-effect genes — no per-gene significance claimed.
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)

LOG2FC_CUTOFF <- 1
MIN_CPM_ORA   <- 5

if (!exists("PYRAMID_LINEAGE")) PYRAMID_LINEAGE <- c(pyramid_all, "Cycling BP")
if (!exists("INTERNEURON_CLUSTERS"))
  INTERNEURON_CLUSTERS <- c("Interneuron I", "Interneuron II", "Interneuron III")
ora_clusters <- intersect(unique(c(PYRAMID_LINEAGE, INTERNEURON_CLUSTERS)),
                          unique(as.character(DE_combined_all$cluster_named)))

run_enrichGO <- function(genes) {
  if (length(genes) < 5) return(NULL)
  go <- enrichGO(gene = genes, OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db, keyType = "SYMBOL",
                 ont = "BP", readable = FALSE, minGSSize = 10, maxGSSize = 300,
                 pAdjustMethod = "BH", pvalueCutoff = 0.05, qvalueCutoff = 0.2)
  if (is.null(go) || nrow(go@result) == 0) return(NULL)
  go@result %>%
    mutate(GeneRatio_num = sapply(GeneRatio, function(x) eval(parse(text = x))),
           BgRatio_num   = sapply(BgRatio,   function(x) eval(parse(text = x))),
           RichFactor    = GeneRatio_num / BgRatio_num)
}

go_enrich_results <- list()
for (clust in ora_clusters) {
  de_c <- DE_combined_all %>%
    filter(cluster_named == clust, !is.na(avg_log2FC), mean_cpm > MIN_CPM_ORA)
  up_genes   <- de_c %>% filter(avg_log2FC >  LOG2FC_CUTOFF) %>% pull(gene)
  down_genes <- de_c %>% filter(avg_log2FC < -LOG2FC_CUTOFF) %>% pull(gene)

  res <- list()
  go_up   <- run_enrichGO(up_genes);   if (!is.null(go_up))   res$up   <- go_up   %>% mutate(direction = "up")
  go_down <- run_enrichGO(down_genes); if (!is.null(go_down)) res$down <- go_down %>% mutate(direction = "down")
  if (length(res) > 0) {
    go_enrich_results[[clust]] <- bind_rows(res)
    message("enrichGO '", clust, "': ", length(up_genes), " up / ",
            length(down_genes), " down genes")
  }
}

de_all <- DE %>% filter(!is.na(avg_log2FC), mean_cpm > MIN_CPM_ORA)
res_all <- list()
go_up   <- run_enrichGO(de_all %>% filter(avg_log2FC >  LOG2FC_CUTOFF) %>% pull(gene))
go_down <- run_enrichGO(de_all %>% filter(avg_log2FC < -LOG2FC_CUTOFF) %>% pull(gene))
if (!is.null(go_up))   res_all$up   <- go_up   %>% mutate(direction = "up")
if (!is.null(go_down)) res_all$down <- go_down %>% mutate(direction = "down")
if (length(res_all) > 0) go_enrich_results[["all"]] <- bind_rows(res_all)

if (length(go_enrich_results) == 0) {
  message("No enrichGO results — try lowering LOG2FC_CUTOFF")
} else {
  top_terms <- go_enrich_results %>%
    imap_dfr(~ .x %>% filter(p.adjust < 0.05, Count >= 10) %>%
               arrange(desc(RichFactor)) %>% slice_head(n = 3) %>%
               mutate(cluster = .y))

  plot_data <- imap_dfr(go_enrich_results, function(res, cl) {
    res %>% filter(Description %in% top_terms$Description) %>% mutate(cluster = cl)
  })

  if (nrow(plot_data) > 0) {
    df.enrichGO <- plot_data %>%
      dplyr::select(Description, cluster, direction, GeneRatio_num,
                    p.adjust, Count, RichFactor) %>%
      mutate(logFDR = -log10(p.adjust),
             direction = factor(direction, levels = c("up", "down")),
             Description = factor(Description, levels = rev(unique(Description))))

    p <- ggplot(df.enrichGO, aes(x = cluster, y = Description)) +
      geom_point(aes(color = logFDR, size = Count)) +
      scale_color_gradient(low = "blue", high = "red") +
      scale_size_area(max_size = 10) +
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(x = "Cluster", y = "GO:BP Term", size = "Gene Count",
           color = "-log10(adj. p)",
           title = paste0("ORA (enrichGO) — neuronal | |log2FC|>",
                          LOG2FC_CUTOFF, " [Misspec = vs rest]")) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
      facet_wrap(~direction)

    dir.create("plots/revision/enrichGO", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    ggsave("plots/revision/enrichGO/enrichGO_dot_plot_combined.pdf",
           plot = p, width = 12, height = 8)
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# GENES-BY-CLUSTER TILEPLOTS for enrichGO terms.
# Tile color = pseudobulk log2FC (shared=DKO-vs-WT; Misspec=vs rest).
# =============================================================================
tdir <- "plots/revision/enrichGO/Genes_by_cluster"
dir.create(tdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

ora_top_terms <- go_enrich_results %>%
  imap_dfr(~ .x %>% filter(p.adjust < 0.05) %>%
             arrange(p.adjust) %>% slice_head(n = 80) %>%
             dplyr::select(Description)) %>%
  distinct(Description) %>% pull(Description)

ora_term_to_clusters <- go_enrich_results %>%
  imap_dfr(function(res, cl) {
    res %>% filter(Description %in% ora_top_terms) %>%
      distinct(Description) %>% mutate(cluster = cl)
  }) %>% group_by(Description) %>%
  summarise(clusters = paste(sort(unique(cluster)), collapse = ", "), .groups = "drop")

ora_term_genes <- map_dfr(ora_top_terms, function(term) {
  for (cl in names(go_enrich_results)) {
    res <- go_enrich_results[[cl]]
    row <- res %>% filter(Description == term)
    if (nrow(row) == 0) next
    gid <- row$geneID[1]
    if (is.na(gid) || gid == "") next
    genes <- head(strsplit(gid, "/")[[1]], 50)
    return(tibble(Description = term, gene = genes))
  }
  NULL
})

if (nrow(ora_term_genes) == 0) {
  message("No enrichGO term genes for tileplots")
} else {
  ora_genes_check <- unique(ora_term_genes$gene)
  ora_logfc <- DE_combined_all %>%
    filter(gene %in% ora_genes_check, cluster_named %in% ora_clusters) %>%
    dplyr::select(gene, avg_log2FC, cluster = cluster_named) %>%
    bind_rows(
      DE %>% filter(gene %in% ora_genes_check) %>%
        dplyr::select(gene, avg_log2FC) %>% mutate(cluster = "all")
    )

  ora_term_logfc <- ora_term_genes %>%
    left_join(ora_logfc, by = "gene", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
    filter(!is.na(avg_log2FC))

  tile_size <- 0.3
  for (term in unique(ora_term_logfc$Description)) {
    plot_df <- ora_term_logfc %>% filter(Description == term)
    gene_order <- plot_df %>% group_by(gene) %>%
      summarise(score = mean(abs(avg_log2FC), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      arrange(desc(score)) %>% pull(gene)
    plot_df <- plot_df %>%
      mutate(cluster = factor(cluster, levels = sort(unique(cluster))),
             gene    = factor(gene, levels = gene_order))

    n_genes <- length(unique(plot_df$gene)); n_clusters <- length(unique(plot_df$cluster))
    if (n_genes < 2 || n_clusters < 2) next

    cnote <- ora_term_to_clusters %>% filter(Description == term) %>% pull(clusters)
    if (length(cnote) == 0) cnote <- "Unknown"

    p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = gene, y = cluster, fill = avg_log2FC)) +
      geom_tile(color = "white") +
      scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", midpoint = 0) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
      labs(title = paste0("GO:BP ", term, "\n(Enriched in: ", cnote, ")"),
           x = "Gene", y = "Cluster", fill = "log2FC") +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
            axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
            plot.title  = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")) +
      coord_fixed(ratio = 1)

    suppressWarnings(
      ggsave(file.path(tdir, paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", term), "_tileplot.pdf")),
             plot = p, width = n_genes * tile_size + 3,
             height = n_clusters * tile_size + 2, units = "in")
    )
  }
  message("Wrote enrichGO tileplots")
}
```

```{r DE_gene_plots}

# THIS CHUNK TAKES A LONG TIME TO RUN, SKIP IF NEEDED
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(future)
library(future.apply)



# =============================================================================
# Violin plots for the top genotype-affected genes across pyramidal + Misspecified
# clusters. Runs AFTER the heatmap chunk and inherits its objects:
#   pyr_scope      = pyramidal + Misspecified clusters (ordered)
#   genes_pyr_fc   = strict top-changed gene set (same as the avglog2FC heatmap)
#   FORCE_GENES    = curated always-include genes
# pyramids_seurat is sc_seurat subset to pyr_scope (pyramid-containing clusters).
#
# NOTE on Misspecified clusters: they have NO WT cells, so any WITHIN-cluster
# genotype violin (sections 2-3) is single-sided (DKO only) for them. The plots
# still render the DKO distribution; there is simply no WT to compare against
# within those clusters. This mirrors the heatmap logic where the within-cluster
# DKO-vs-WT contrast is undefined for the genotype-private clusters.
# =============================================================================

# =============================================================================
# Pull the TOP Misspecified vs-rest genes so they're guaranteed a violin/UMAP,
# even if they don't pass the shared-cluster genes_pyr_fc cutoffs. These are the
# strongest markers defining the aberrant clusters (one-vs-rest contrast).
# =============================================================================
N_MISSPEC_TOP <- 25   # top up + top down per Misspecified cluster

misspec_top_genes <- DE_combined_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(comparison == "Misspec_vs_Rest", !is.na(avg_log2FC),
                mean_cpm > 5) %>%                       # expression floor, drop noise
  dplyr::group_by(cluster_named) %>%
  dplyr::group_modify(~ dplyr::bind_rows(
    dplyr::slice_max(.x, avg_log2FC, n = N_MISSPEC_TOP),   # top up-changes
    dplyr::slice_min(.x, avg_log2FC, n = N_MISSPEC_TOP)    # top down-changes
  )) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::pull(gene) %>%
  unique()

message("Adding ", length(misspec_top_genes),
        " top Misspecified vs-rest genes to the violin/UMAP set")


# --- Output dirs ---
viol_dir <- "plots/revision/Violin"
dir.create(file.path(viol_dir, "default"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(viol_dir, "nonzero"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Genes you ALWAYS want violins for, regardless of whether they passed selection
VIOLIN_ALWAYS <- unique(c("Nr4a2", "Rorb", "Neurod1", "Satb2","Bcl11b",
               "Fezf2","Unc5d","Cux2","Cux1","Eomes","Pax6","Tbr1","Neurod2","Neurod6","Btg2","Id2","Id3",
               "Epha3","Robo2","Top2a","Hs6st3","Tafa2","Gad1", "Gad2", "Lhx6","Reln","Rmst","Nfib","Zbtb20",
               "Cdk14", "Sox6", "Npas3", "Scrt2", "Ntng2", "Sox2ot", "Dach1", "Dpp10", "Gad1", "Tcf7l2", "Dgkg",
               "Gabra2", "Elmod1", "Fam135b", "Hhip", "Gpat3", "Adcy7", "Dkk2", "Scube2", "Crlf1", "Sox2", "Mki67", "Pcna", "Tubb3", "Dcx", "Map2", "Ncam1", "Rbfox3", "Gap43", "Neurod1", "Egfr", "Bdnf", "Eno2", "Scrt2", "Pou3f3", "Pou3f2", "Satb2", "Bcl11b", "Sox5", "Pou3f1", "Rorb", "Olig2", "Sox2",  "Hes1", "Hes5", "Notch1", "Notch2", "Tubb3", "Dcx", "Ncam1", "Robo1", "Robo2", "Ebf1", "Grin1", "Ebf2", "Ebf3", "Dll1", "Kdm1a", "Hdac9", "Cdkn1c", "Insm1", "Smarcd3", "Dpf3", "Tiam2", "Pak3","Hes6","Gadd45g", "Prox1","Emx2","Nhlh1","Ptprd","Bcl11a","Lmo1", "Sema3a","Sema3c","Hrk", "Lhx6","Runx1t1","Cxcr4","Ackr3","Dlx2","Pvalb","Sst","Htr3a","Mast1","Adck1"))  

temp <- c("Runx1t1","Cxcr4","Ackr3","Dlx2","Pvalb","Sst","Htr3a","Mast1","Adck1")

VIOLIN_GENES <- union(union(genes_pyr_fc, FORCE_GENES),
                      union(VIOLIN_ALWAYS, misspec_top_genes))   
VIOLIN_GENES <- intersect(VIOLIN_GENES, rownames(sc_seurat))

message("Violin gene set: ", length(VIOLIN_GENES), " genes across ",
        length(pyr_scope), " clusters")

# --- Build the pyramidal subset ONCE, with ordered cluster levels ---
pyramids_seurat <- subset(sc_seurat, subset = cluster_named %in% pyr_scope)
pyramids_seurat$cluster_named <- factor(pyramids_seurat$cluster_named,
                                        levels = pyr_scope)
DefaultAssay(pyramids_seurat) <- "RNA"

genotype_colors <- c("WT" = "grey80", "NeuroD2_D6DKO" = "firebrick")

options(future.globals.maxSize = 8 * 1024^3)
plan(sequential)

# --- Progress helper: prints every `every` iterations, plus first and last ---
progress_msg <- function(i, total, label, every = 10) {
  if (i == 1 || i == total || i %% every == 0) {
    message(sprintf("  [%s] %d / %d (%.0f%%)", label, i, total, 100 * i / total))
  }
}

n_genes    <- length(VIOLIN_GENES)
n_clusters <- length(pyr_scope)
n_pairs    <- n_genes * n_clusters

# =============================================================================
# 1. All clusters — split-violin
# =============================================================================
message("=== Section 1: all-cluster split violins (", n_genes, " genes) ===")
invisible(Map(function(gene, i) {
  progress_msg(i, n_genes, "1: all-cluster split", every = 10)
  if (!gene %in% rownames(pyramids_seurat)) return(NULL)
  p <- VlnPlot(pyramids_seurat, features = gene,
               group.by = "cluster_named", split.by = "Genotype",
               cols = genotype_colors, pt.size = 0.1, combine = TRUE) +
    ggtitle(gene) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  suppressWarnings(
    ggsave(file.path(viol_dir, "default", paste0(gene, "_all_clusters_violin.pdf")),
         plot = p, width = 8, height = 4)
    )
}, VIOLIN_GENES, seq_along(VIOLIN_GENES)))
message("Section 1 done.")

# =============================================================================
# 2. Per-cluster — default violin
# =============================================================================
message("=== Section 2: per-cluster violins (", n_pairs, " gene×cluster) ===")
gene_vec    <- rep(VIOLIN_GENES, each = n_clusters)
cluster_vec <- rep(pyr_scope,    times = n_genes)
invisible(Map(function(gene, cluster, i) {
  progress_msg(i, n_pairs, "2: per-cluster", every = 25)
  sub <- subset(pyramids_seurat, subset = cluster_named == cluster)
  if (!gene %in% rownames(sub)) return(NULL)
  p <- VlnPlot(sub, features = gene, group.by = "Genotype",
               cols = genotype_colors, pt.size = 0.1) +
    ggtitle(paste0(gene, " — ", cluster)) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
  safe_cluster <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", cluster)
  suppressWarnings(
    ggsave(file.path(viol_dir, "default", paste0(gene, "-", safe_cluster, "_violin.pdf")),
         plot = p, width = 4, height = 4)
  )
}, gene_vec, cluster_vec, seq_along(gene_vec)))
message("Section 2 done.")

# =============================================================================
# 3. Per-cluster — nonzero
# =============================================================================
message("=== Section 3: per-cluster nonzero violins (", n_pairs, " gene×cluster) ===")
invisible(Map(function(gene, cluster, i) {
  progress_msg(i, n_pairs, "3: per-cluster nonzero", every = 25)
  sub <- subset(pyramids_seurat, subset = cluster_named == cluster)
  if (!gene %in% rownames(sub)) return(NULL)
  expr <- FetchData(sub, vars = c(gene, "Genotype")) %>% filter(.data[[gene]] > 0)
  if (nrow(expr) == 0) return(NULL)
  p <- ggplot(expr, aes(x = Genotype, y = .data[[gene]], fill = Genotype)) +
    geom_violin(trim = FALSE, scale = "width") +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 0.5, alpha = 0.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = genotype_colors) +
    theme_minimal() +
    ggtitle(paste0(gene, " — ", cluster)) + ylab("Expression") +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
  safe_cluster <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", cluster)
  suppressWarnings(
    ggsave(file.path(viol_dir, "nonzero", paste0(gene, "-", safe_cluster, "_nonzero_violin.pdf")),
         plot = p, width = 4, height = 4)
  )
}, gene_vec, cluster_vec, seq_along(gene_vec)))
message("Section 3 done.")

# =============================================================================
# 4. All clusters — nonzero dodged
# =============================================================================
message("=== Section 4: all-cluster nonzero violins (", n_genes, " genes) ===")
invisible(Map(function(gene, i) {
  progress_msg(i, n_genes, "4: all-cluster nonzero", every = 10)
  if (!gene %in% rownames(pyramids_seurat)) return(NULL)
  expr <- FetchData(pyramids_seurat, vars = c(gene, "cluster_named", "Genotype")) %>%
    filter(.data[[gene]] > 0)
  if (nrow(expr) == 0) return(NULL)
  p <- ggplot(expr, aes(x = cluster_named, y = .data[[gene]], fill = Genotype)) +
    geom_violin(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), trim = FALSE, scale = "width") +
    geom_jitter(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.2, dodge.width = 0.8),
                size = 0.5, alpha = 0.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = genotype_colors) +
    theme_minimal() + ggtitle(gene) + ylab("Expression") +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  suppressWarnings(
    ggsave(file.path(viol_dir, "nonzero", paste0(gene, "_all_clusters_nonzero_violin.pdf")),
         plot = p, width = 9, height = 4)
  )
}, temp, seq_along(temp))) # VIOLIN_GENES, seq_along(VIOLIN_GENES)))
message("Section 4 done.")

# =============================================================================
# 5. Pooled across all pyramidal clusters — one WT-vs-DKO violin per gene.
#    Cluster identity is collapsed: every pyramidal cell contributes to a single
#    genotype comparison. "Averaged over all pyramids."
# =============================================================================
dir.create(file.path(viol_dir, "pooled"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
message("=== Section 5: pooled pyramidal violins (", n_genes, " genes) ===")

invisible(Map(function(gene, i) {
  progress_msg(i, n_genes, "5: pooled pyramidal", every = 10)
  if (!gene %in% rownames(pyramids_seurat)) return(NULL)

  p <- VlnPlot(pyramids_seurat, features = gene,
               group.by = "Genotype",          # collapse clusters -> genotype only
               cols = genotype_colors, pt.size = 0) +
    ggtitle(paste0(gene, " - all pyramidal cells")) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
    NoLegend()
  suppressWarnings(
    ggsave(file.path(viol_dir, "pooled", paste0(gene, "_pooled_pyramids_violin.pdf")),
           plot = p, width = 3.5, height = 4)
  )
}, temp, seq_along(temp))) #VIOLIN_GENES, seq_along(VIOLIN_GENES)))
message("Section 5 done.")

# Reset parallel plan so it doesn't leak into later chunks
plan(sequential)
```

```{r proportion_analysis}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)

dir.create("plots/revision/proportions", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

DKO <- "NeuroD2_D6DKO"; WT_LAB <- "WT"

# =============================================================================
# Cell-type proportion shift, DKO vs WT. DESCRIPTIVE ONLY: n=1 per genotype means
# proportions are single observations — no valid significance test (a cell-level
# test would be pseudoreplicated). We report counts, within-genotype proportions,
# and the DKO/WT ratio, framed as a single-replicate compositional description.
# =============================================================================

# Per-cluster counts by genotype
comp <- sc_seurat@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::count(cluster_named, Genotype, name = "n_cells") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Genotype, values_from = n_cells, values_fill = 0)

# Within-genotype proportions (each genotype's cells summing to 1) + ratio
geno_totals <- sc_seurat@meta.data %>% dplyr::count(Genotype, name = "total")
tot_WT  <- geno_totals$total[geno_totals$Genotype == WT_LAB]
tot_DKO <- geno_totals$total[geno_totals$Genotype == DKO]

comp <- comp %>%
  mutate(
    prop_WT   = .data[[WT_LAB]] / tot_WT,
    prop_DKO  = .data[[DKO]]    / tot_DKO,
    # log2 ratio of proportions (descriptive effect size; +pseudocount for zeros)
    log2_ratio = log2((prop_DKO + 1e-4) / (prop_WT + 1e-4)),
    pct_WT    = round(100 * prop_WT, 2),
    pct_DKO   = round(100 * prop_DKO, 2)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(log2_ratio))

write.table(comp, "Revision_celltype_proportions_DKO_vs_WT.csv",
            sep = ",", row.names = FALSE)
print(comp %>% dplyr::select(cluster_named, !!WT_LAB, !!DKO,
                             pct_WT, pct_DKO, log2_ratio))

# =============================================================================
# Targeted UL-vs-DL summary — the specific reviewer claim. Group the layer
# clusters into upper-layer (UL) and deep-layer (DL) identities + Misspecified.
# ADJUST these groupings to your layer biology.
# =============================================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

DKO <- "NeuroD2_D6DKO"; WT_LAB <- "WT"

tot <- sc_seurat@meta.data %>% dplyr::count(Genotype, name = "total")
tot_WT  <- tot$total[tot$Genotype == WT_LAB]
tot_DKO <- tot$total[tot$Genotype == DKO]

UL_CLUSTERS  <- c("Layer II/III", "Layer IV")
DL_CLUSTERS  <- c("Layer V", "Layer VI", "Layer VIb")

# Keep Misspecified UL and DL as SEPARATE categories (do not merge)
fate_summary <- sc_seurat@meta.data %>%
  mutate(fate = dplyr::case_when(
    cluster_named %in% UL_CLUSTERS        ~ "Upper-layer (UL)",
    cluster_named %in% DL_CLUSTERS        ~ "Deep-layer (DL)",
    cluster_named == "Misspecified UL"    ~ "Misspecified UL",
    cluster_named == "Misspecified DL"    ~ "Misspecified DL",
    TRUE ~ "Other")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(fate != "Other") %>%
  dplyr::count(fate, Genotype, name = "n_cells") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Genotype, values_from = n_cells, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(
    prop_WT    = .data[[WT_LAB]] / tot_WT,
    prop_DKO   = .data[[DKO]]    / tot_DKO,
    pct_WT     = round(100 * prop_WT, 2),
    pct_DKO    = round(100 * prop_DKO, 2),
    log2_ratio = round(log2((prop_DKO + 1e-4) / (prop_WT + 1e-4)), 3)) %>%
  arrange(desc(log2_ratio))

print(fate_summary)
write.table(fate_summary, "Revision_UL_DL_fate_proportions_split.csv",
            sep = ",", row.names = FALSE)

print(fate_summary)

# =============================================================================
# PLOTS
# =============================================================================
# 1. Stacked composition bar (every cluster, per genotype)
comp_long <- sc_seurat@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::count(cluster_named, Genotype, name = "n") %>%
  group_by(Genotype) %>% mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>% ungroup()


library(Polychrome)
set.seed(42)  # palette generation is stochastic; seed for reproducibility
n_clusters <- length(unique(comp_long$cluster_named))
cluster_pal <- as.character(createPalette(n_clusters,
                                          seedcolors = c("#FF0000", "#00FF00", "#0000FF")))
names(cluster_pal) <- sort(unique(as.character(comp_long$cluster_named)))

p_stack <- ggplot(comp_long, aes(x = Genotype, y = prop, fill = cluster_named)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_pal) +
  labs(y = "Proportion of cells", x = NULL, fill = "Cluster",
       title = "Cell-type composition by genotype (n=1 each; descriptive)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 7), legend.key.size = unit(3, "mm"))
ggsave("plots/revision/proportions/composition_stacked.pdf", p_stack,
       width = 7, height = 8)

# 2. UL/DL/Misspecified grouped bar — the direct answer to the reviewer
fate_long <- fate_summary %>%
  dplyr::select(fate, pct_WT, pct_DKO) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(c(pct_WT, pct_DKO), names_to = "Genotype", values_to = "pct") %>%
  mutate(Genotype = ifelse(Genotype == "pct_WT", "WT", "DKO"),
         Genotype = factor(Genotype, levels = c("WT", "DKO")),
         fate = factor(fate, levels = c("Upper-layer (UL)", "Deep-layer (DL)", "Misspecified")))

p_fate <- ggplot(fate_long, aes(x = fate, y = pct, fill = Genotype)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("WT" = "grey70", "DKO" = "firebrick")) +
  labs(y = "% of genotype's cells", x = NULL,
       title = "UL vs DL neuronal proportions (n=1 each; descriptive)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1))
ggsave("plots/revision/proportions/UL_DL_fate_barplot.pdf", p_fate,
       width = 6, height = 5)

# 3. log2-ratio dotplot across all clusters (which expand / contract in DKO)
p_ratio <- comp %>%
  mutate(cluster_named = factor(cluster_named, levels = cluster_named[order(log2_ratio)])) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = log2_ratio, y = cluster_named,
             color = log2_ratio > 0, size = pmax(pct_WT, pct_DKO))) +
  geom_point() + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "steelblue", "TRUE" = "firebrick"),
                     labels = c("Depleted in DKO", "Enriched in DKO"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "log2(DKO prop / WT prop)", y = NULL, size = "max % cells",
       title = "Compositional shift by cluster (n=1 each; descriptive)") +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave("plots/revision/proportions/compositional_shift_dotplot.pdf", p_ratio,
       width = 7, height = 7)

message("Proportion analysis complete. ",
        "NOTE: single replicate per genotype — proportions are descriptive, ",
        "no significance test is valid.")
```

```{r interneuron_analysis}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)

dir.create("plots/revision/interneurons", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

DKO <- "NeuroD2_D6DKO"; WT_LAB <- "WT"
INTERNEURON_CLUSTERS <- c("Interneuron I", "Interneuron II", "Interneuron III")
in_present <- intersect(INTERNEURON_CLUSTERS, unique(as.character(sc_seurat$cluster_named)))

# =============================================================================
# Are Neurod2/Neurod6 actually expressed in interneurons here? (Reviewer notes
# they're "weakly expressed" — confirm in YOUR data before interpreting effects.)
# =============================================================================
nd_genes <- intersect(c("Neurod2", "Neurod6"), rownames(sc_seurat))
nd_expr <- FetchData(sc_seurat, vars = c(nd_genes, "cluster_named", "Genotype")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(cluster_named %in% c(in_present, "Layer V", "Layer II/III")) %>%  # vs pyramidal ref
  tidyr::pivot_longer(all_of(nd_genes), names_to = "gene", values_to = "expr") %>%
  group_by(cluster_named, Genotype, gene) %>%
  summarise(mean_expr = mean(expr), pct_expr = 100 * mean(expr > 0), .groups = "drop")
write.table(nd_expr, "Revision_interneuron_NeuroD_expression.csv",
            sep = ",", row.names = FALSE)
print(nd_expr)

# =============================================================================
# DKO-vs-WT pseudobulk log2FC per interneuron cluster (same descriptive pipeline
# as the main analysis — these are SHARED clusters with both genotypes, so the
# within-cluster DKO-vs-WT contrast IS defined here, unlike the Misspecified ones).
# Reuses pseudobulk_log2fc() from the DEresults chunk.
# =============================================================================
interneuron_DE <- purrr::map(in_present, function(cl) {
  res <- pseudobulk_log2fc(sc_seurat, group_label = cl, min_cells = 20)
  if (!is.null(res)) res$cluster_named <- cl
  res
}) %>% purrr::compact() %>% dplyr::bind_rows()

if (nrow(interneuron_DE) == 0) {
  message("No interneuron clusters passed the cell-count threshold (need >=20 ",
          "cells per genotype). Interneuron numbers may be too low for pseudobulk.")
} else {
  interneuron_DE$comparison <- "DKO_vs_WT"
  write.table(interneuron_DE, "Revision_interneuron_DKO_vs_WT_pseudobulk.csv",
              sep = ",", row.names = FALSE)

  # How many genes show substantial change per interneuron cluster?
  change_summary <- interneuron_DE %>%
    dplyr::filter(mean_cpm > 5) %>%
    group_by(cluster_named) %>%
    summarise(
      n_tested      = n(),
      n_up_fc1      = sum(avg_log2FC >  1, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_down_fc1    = sum(avg_log2FC < -1, na.rm = TRUE),
      max_abs_log2FC = round(max(abs(avg_log2FC), na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      .groups = "drop")
  print(change_summary)

  # Top changed genes per interneuron cluster (descriptive)
  top_changed <- interneuron_DE %>%
    dplyr::filter(mean_cpm > 5) %>%
    group_by(cluster_named) %>%
    slice_max(abs(avg_log2FC), n = 20) %>%
    arrange(cluster_named, desc(avg_log2FC)) %>%
    dplyr::select(cluster_named, gene, avg_log2FC, cpm_WT, cpm_DKO, mean_cpm)
  write.table(top_changed, "Revision_interneuron_top_changed_genes.csv",
              sep = ",", row.names = FALSE)

  # Volcano-style plot per cluster (log2FC vs mean expression, since no p-values)
  p_vol <- interneuron_DE %>%
    dplyr::filter(mean_cpm > 1) %>%
    mutate(changed = abs(avg_log2FC) > 1) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = log2(mean_cpm + 1), y = avg_log2FC, color = changed)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.4, size = 0.6) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "grey70", "TRUE" = "firebrick"),
                       labels = c("|log2FC|<=1", "|log2FC|>1"), name = NULL) +
    facet_wrap(~cluster_named) +
    labs(x = "log2(mean CPM + 1)", y = "log2FC (DKO vs WT)",
         title = "Interneuron DKO-vs-WT changes (descriptive; n=1 per genotype)") +
    theme_minimal()
  ggsave("plots/revision/interneurons/interneuron_MA_plots.pdf", p_vol,
         width = 10, height = 4)
}

# =============================================================================
# Interneuron GSEA/ORA: we ALREADY have these — the interneuron clusters are in
# gsea_clusters and ora_clusters (neuronal scope). To surface them specifically,
# pull the interneuron results from the existing objects:
# =============================================================================
if (exists("gsea_results")) {
  in_gsea <- intersect(in_present, names(gsea_results))
  for (cl in in_gsea) {
    df <- get_gsea_df(gsea_results[[cl]]) %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(p.adjust)) %>% arrange(p.adjust) %>% head(20)
    if (nrow(df) > 0) {
      write.table(df %>% dplyr::select(ID, Description, NES, p.adjust, setSize),
                  paste0("Revision_interneuron_GSEA_",
                         gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", cl), ".csv"),
                  sep = ",", row.names = FALSE)
      message("Wrote GSEA top terms for ", cl)
    }
  }
}
```
